Project & Construction

Elysian Rise is currently at the piling stage, the substructure work is actively underway. This marks a strategic window for off-plan investors to secure units at the most favorable entry pricing.

Based on comprehensive soil tests and structural evaluations, the approved piling specification for Elysian Rise is 18 metres in depth with an 800mm diameter. At Strongmas, we are strictly executing this standard to ensure optimal load-bearing capacity and long-term structural integrity.

Elysian Rise is projected for completion within 36 months—comprising 24 months dedicated to structural construction and an additional 12 months for luxury interior finishes and final handover.

We utilize only premium-grade cement, including top-tier options from Dangote and Lafarge, to guarantee superior structural integrity and long-term durability.

We comply with international steel reinforcement codes, with high-tensile rods and quality mesh in all structural elements, supervised by certified engineers.
